Ontology Explained

Philosophy & AI

Ontology Explained is a place that provides clear, interesting, and edifying discussions about topics involving philosophy and artificial intelligence.

After earning my PhD in philosophy, I found my way into AI as an ontologist. I'm here to evangelize, educate, demystify, and hopefully entertain viewers at the intersection of philosophy and AI. My videos will include general introductions to dense or interesting topics, tutorials to create your own ontologies, business insights into the value of technologies, and more philosophical things.

If Anyone Analyzes It... Everyone Dies

9 videos, 4 hr 58 min

In this playlist, I go through Yudkowsky and Soares' book If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies. I'm starting out a skeptic, but we'll see where a charitable exegesis of the arguments leaves me (and you!).

You're welcome to read along, or just watch; I'll make sure there is enough context for everyone regardless.

  1. An Honest Breakdown of Eliezer Yudkowsky's AI Doom Book19:56
  2. The Case for Superintelligence Is Surprisingly Thin | If Anyone Builds It... Chapter 136:43
  3. Are AIs "Grown" or Built? Analyzing Chapter 2 of If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies44:15
  4. Does AI Really Want Anything? | If Anyone Builds It... Chapter 328:32
  5. Can We Predict What AI Will Want? | Yudkowsky & Soares Chapter 4 Part 130:39
  6. Yudkowsky and Soares Needed an Editor | Chapter 4, Part 2 of If Anyone Builds It33:23
  7. Will Superintelligent AI Want to Kill Us? | Chapter 538:27

11 videos, 2 hr 50 min
